source_comparison.method: Token comparison preserves strings, ignores comments/whitespace/optional trailing commas, and normalizes family visibility, qualified memory paths, explicit private-payload access replacing Deref/DerefMut, and allocation/constructor/accessor routing. All other allocation/release/Drop/registry/pin bodies match. Review aid, not formal refinement.

limitations: Mechanical source comparisons aid review, not formal refinement.
ChargedFrames Drop remains active, including physical allocator entry and failure logging; wider caller/IRQ/guard/destructor qualification remains open.
RetiredMemory abandonment retains complete backing; terminal physical failure grants no retry or custody.
Injected release rejection deliberately retains one frame/node/charge, not an aggregate physical exhaustion measurement.
No broader pressure/fairness, model change or attribution of historical scheduler/metrics/root-close/mapping failures.
Tracked boot diffs omit untracked new modules; explicit frozen Rust hashes identify the complete changed source set.
